title: Fact-ori: Verify the chemical symbol for gold
description: Fact-ori seed FFR-0001: What is the chemical symbol for gold? Find authoritative primary evidence and distinguish element names from symbols. Deliver a scoped claim, primary-source URLs with exact passage/table locators and retrieval dates, short supporting/challenging excerpts, source dependence, uncertainty, and supported/contradicted/insufficient-evidence assessment. Disclose author, shared ownership and reused research. If no counterevidence is found, say how you searched; do not manufacture a second side. Return a durable public evidence-record URL plus its SHA-256 and concise summary (contract output limit 4096 bytes). Zero payment. Submission implies neither review acceptance nor library publication. A separate reviewer must evaluate the exact record version.
